notes: Input study identifiers, descriptions and locators are empty. The assigned report explicitly identifies a single-trace target (coded claim 4), which was matched independently to original p. 1206 and replication output p. 7 (S1 ON LMIFEP: 0.039, SE 0.022, Est./S.E. 1.770, p 0.077). Original .04 is the spring-first-grade residual group gap, not the targeted K–1 growth coefficient, so .144 is retained for the same test as p < .0001. Replication metric ser_method is not printed; the printed unstandardized coefficient is retained without conversion. Original title/author/journal verified in retrieved full PDF. Replication report and estimation output acquired through its primary OSF project. Original DOI landing returned 403; Unpaywall and OpenAlex offered no OA copy; original full text was obtained from the replication project Analysis component. No data files were inspected.
